fact: On 9 December 2025 the DGDDL launched in Assinie Mafia the return of the PAMREC taxpayer census database (2009 taxpayers identified, up 20% on the year before) and awareness of the taxpayer portal and digital payments, in a pilot project for own-source revenue.
title: Côte d’Ivoire-AIP/ La DGDDL lance la sensibilisation des contribuables à Assinie Mafia pour la mobilisation des revenus propres des communes
